profile.basicZh: 程振，中国石油大学（华东）管理学博士，硕士生导师，讲师。
profile.basicEn: Zhen Cheng holds a Ph.D. in Management from China University of Petroleum (East China) and is a lecturer and master's supervisor.
researchZh: 算电协同与智能经济新形态
researchEn: Credit enhancement through accounting data standards
Computing-power–electricity coordination and new forms of smart economy
profile.projectsSummaryZh: 主持安徽省社科基金青年项目1项、厅市级项目2项、阜阳师范大学青年人才基金重点项目1项。参与四项国家、省级与教育部课题，以及一项横向课题。
profile.projectsSummaryEn: Principal investigator for one Anhui Provincial Social Science Fund Youth Project, two department- and municipal-level projects, and one key project of the Fuyang Normal University Youth Talent Fund. Participant in four national, provincial, and Ministry of Education projects, as well as one industry-sponsored project.
profile.publicationsSummaryZh: 近五年在以第一作者/通讯作者在 International Review of Economics & Finance、Energy、Journal of Cleaner Production、中国人口·资源与环境、产业经济研究、商业研究、经济问题探索、江淮时报、技术经济与管理研究等国内外学术期刊（中科院1区/国家自然科学基金委认定的B类/FMS高质量中文期刊/CSSCI）上发表学术论文10余篇。
profile.publicationsSummaryEn: In the past five years, as first author or corresponding author, he has published more than ten academic papers in domestic and international journals and outlets including International Review of Economics & Finance, Energy, Journal of Cleaner Production, China Population, Resources and Environment, Industrial Economics Research, Commercial Research, Inquiry into Economic Issues, Jianghuai Times, and Technoeconomics & Management Research. These include CAS Q1 journals, Category B journals recognized by the National Natural Science Foundation of China, FMS high-quality Chinese journals, and CSSCI journals.
profile.serviceZh: International Review of Economics & Finance、International Review of Financial Analysis、Environmental Engineering and Management Journal、Frontiers in Public Health、PLOS ONE、Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems 等多个期刊审稿人。
profile.serviceEn: Reviewer for International Review of Economics & Finance, International Review of Financial Analysis, Environmental Engineering and Management Journal, Frontiers in Public Health, PLOS ONE, Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems, and other journals.
profile.recruitmentZh: 工商管理学硕士（会计学、企业管理、技术经济及管理）；会计专业硕士（MPAcc）
profile.recruitmentEn: Academic Master of Business Administration students in accounting, enterprise management, and technological economics and management; Master of Professional Accounting (MPAcc) students.
